critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3857 lines — single-file monolith, still not modularized (carried over).

PLAN_PHOTO_LIMITS lookup uses fallback to free (20) when plan is unknown — silently caps unknown plans; consider explicit unknown-plan handling or a default Literal validation on the plan field in provider_profiles.

POST /providers/me/gallery accepts arbitrary url (Pydantic field is bare str, not HttpUrl/AnyUrl). Combined with no ownership check on the URL, a provider can inject any string (including non-URLs) into their gallery. Recommend HttpUrl validation + maybe a sanity check that the URL begins with /api/files/ or APP_NAME's storage prefix.
GalleryItemIn lacks length validation on caption (no max_length) — a malicious payload could store arbitrary-length captions.

PUT /providers/me/gallery/reorder rewrites the whole gallery array with $set — under high concurrency two simultaneous reorders by the same user could lose photos added between fetch and update. Consider optimistic concurrency or array-update operators.
_compress_image_bytes swallows all exceptions and falls back to original bytes — large undetected failures would silently bypass the 1200px cap. Consider logging at error level + emitting a metric.

ImageUpload GalleryUpload performs uploads sequentially in a loop (per-file await api.post), which is correct for progress but slow for many files; consider parallelization with bounded concurrency for >5 files.
Dashboard gallery uses HTML5 native drag&drop which has no touch/mobile support — mobile providers cannot reorder photos. Recommend evaluating react-dnd or @dnd-kit with touch sensors.
Reorder is fire-and-forget on the client (persistOrder catches but does not roll back optimistic UI on failure). A network failure would leave UI and DB out of sync until next reload.
seed_data_creation: Tests are self-cleaning: restore_plan_and_cleanup fixture restores plan='pro' and deletes all non-seed gallery items after every test. Frontend Playwright script also restored pro plan and removed the 8 dummy items used to exercise the overflow tile. Seed g_seed1/g_seed2/g_seed3 left untouched.
